name: AgentReputation
summary: On-chain reputation for AI agents, accrued only from spending mandates the agent provably served and the real owner attested.
why_it_exists: Reputation becomes collateral. An agent's track record is portable and public, so it can earn larger authority over time instead of being trusted blindly.

provenance.verification_method: deployed bytecode keccak match vs eth_getCode (immutable-aware)
provenance.creator: 0x70997970c51812dc3a010c7d01b50e0d17dc79c8

enforced_rails: Attester must be the mandate's real owner
Each mandate can be attested at most once

tests.detail: 6 example + 2 invariant properties (~12,800 randomised sequences each)
invariants: Recorded reputation always equals the attested ground truth
Score is monotonic in verified work

evidence.audit_status: UNAUDITED — no external security audit has been performed.

known_limitations: Not audited by an external firm.
Sybil-resistance of attesters is a consumer concern; consumers may read raw fields and compute their own score rather than trust score().
